events.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT f.file_id AS test_file_path
FROM auto_ontology_code.code.files f
JOIN auto_ontology_code.code.imports i ON i.file_id = f.file_id
WHERE f.is_test = true
AND (
    i.module_name = 'auto_ontology/semantic/visit_enter.py'
    OR f.module = 'test_visit_enter'
);
